course_name: 外語群/英語文專長教學實習
outline: This course is designed as an intensive teacher training program for students to become effective EFL teachers. Students are required to do the microteaching and present some selected chapters from the textbooks.
schedule:
A detailed syllabus will be distributed on the first day of class.
W1. Course Introduction
W2. Lesson Planning
W3. International Education
W4. Testing & Assessment Design
W5. AI Technology for ELT
W6. Invited Talk: Bilingual Education
W7. Invited Talk: Curriculum Design
W8. Classroom Observation
W9. Midterm
W10. Teaching Demonstration
W11. Teaching Demonstration
W12. Teaching Demonstration
W13. Joint workshop organized by the Teacher Education Center
W14. Textbooks and Materials Evaluation
W15. Report on the Teaching Internship
W16. Mock Interview & Portfolio Demonstration
W17. Invited Talk: Planning for a successful teaching career
W18. Final
assessment:
Teaching Demonstration + Lesson Plans (drafts & revision): 30%
Teaching Intern & Report (classroom observantion/reflections/teaching video): 30%
Mock Interview & Portfolio (CV, biography, teaching philosophy, teaching materials, etc.): 10%
Attendance and Participation: 15%
Final: 15%
